name: 🏏 Wacky Bats 💥
desc:
Welcome to Wacky Bats! Grab a bat and send your friends across the map!

🏆 Climb the leaderboards and become the best!
💯 Get the highest killstreak and use special killstreak bats!
🤣 Play around with the ragdoll and knockback physics!

💞 Join the group and leave a like to support the game!

⚠️ Cheaters will be instantly banned without appeals.
